words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِى}} ({{tr:alladhī}}) makes 104:2 dependent on the prior verdict and epithet in 104:1. The pronoun does not introduce a new actor; it resumes that prior type (104:1) and turns it into a behavioral profile: the one who gathered wealth and counted it. Its definite relative form can specify an indefinite universal type without making the referent a named individual, while the possible attachment analyses tighten or restate the same referent rather than changing it. The result is compact cohesion: the relative pronoun controls both pro-dropped verb subjects, and the object suffix later returns to the same wealth.

words.prose: {{ar:جَمَعَ}} ({{tr:jamaʿa}}) is not left as generic assembly. Its explicit object, {{ar:مَالًۭا}} ({{tr:mālan}}), makes the action material accumulation, and the perfect form presents that accumulation as part of the relative figure's established profile. The root's image of drawing scattered things into one collected whole remains active as concentration: wealth is pulled inward instead of dispersed. Variant and sound evidence can intensify that picture through {{ar:جَمَّعَ}} ({{tr:jammaʿa}}), but the aligned surface remains Form I, so the strongest visible iteration is reserved for {{ar:عَدَّدَهُۥ}} ({{tr:ʿaddadahū}}). The echo with 70:18 helps mark gathering as a hoarding-field verb, while 104:2 specializes that field by moving from gathered wealth to counted wealth.

words.prose: {{ar:مَالًۭا}} ({{tr:mālan}}) gives the first verb its tangible object. As an indefinite accusative mass noun, it keeps the category open: wealth of any kind is what gets gathered. The noun then becomes the antecedent of the suffix in {{ar:عَدَّدَهُۥ}} ({{tr:ʿaddadahū}}), so the same wealth moves from gathered object to counted object. Its non-possessive form also prepares the shift in 104:3, where the next occurrence makes the wealth possessed. Root-family evidence keeps the property sense concrete and possessible, almost herd-like, while inclination pressure makes wealth the thing the subject leans toward before repeated measurement. Distributional pressure also keeps this from being generic possession: the wealth is immediately pulled into a marked accumulation-and-counting frame.

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa-}}) is the hinge between acquisition and enumeration. It coordinates {{ar:عَدَّدَهُۥ}} ({{tr:ʿaddadahū}}) with {{ar:جَمَعَ}} ({{tr:jamaʿa}}), keeping both actions inside the same relative clause and under the same subject from {{ar:ٱلَّذِى}} ({{tr:alladhī}}). The main force is not a subordinate while-clause: counting becomes a second finite act. Still, the short proclitic is fused to the doubled verb in recitation, so the two actions feel tightly coupled as gathered wealth turns into measured wealth.

words.prose: {{ar:عَدَّدَهُۥ}} ({{tr:ʿaddadahū}}) closes the ayah by acting again on the wealth already gathered. As a finite Form II perfect, it makes enumeration an agency-bearing trait, not a detached tally; the doubled consonant and the form's iterative force make the counting feel repeated. The suffix {{ar:هُۥ}} ({{tr:-hū}}) loops back to {{ar:مَالًۭا}} ({{tr:mālan}}), so the wealth is compressed into the final verb and becomes the last audible object of the ayah. Root-family evidence lets counting shade into reckoning, boundedness, and readiness, but the local form selects repeated enumeration rather than the Form IV preparation branch. The variant {{ar:وَعَدَدَهُ}} ({{tr:wa-ʿadadahu}}) exposes how much the doubling controls the difference between repeated action and a simpler number-reading; 104:3 then continues the suffix chain from counted wealth to possessed wealth and its claimed effect.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence جَمَعَ مَالًا وَعَدَّدَهُ makes wealth the product of one active operation and the pronominal object of a second.
baseline_models.mechanism: Dispersed assets are consolidated into a possessed whole and then rendered repeatedly inspectable through enumeration; gathering makes the stock, while counting maintains cognitive and practical control over it.

activation_trace.role: The consolidation of scattered parts supplies the inward motion by which separate assets become one controlled stock.
Acquired and abundant property supplies the substance being consolidated and controlled.
Enumeration turns the collected stock into discrete, reviewable units and closes the control loop.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely identifies someone who has much money.
changed_reading.after: The verse depicts an operation: he converts dispersed assets into a controlled whole and keeps that whole present to himself by tallying it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: جَمَعَ and the intensive عَدَّدَ can be read prospectively around مَالًا, not only as a report of completed possession.
baseline_models.mechanism: Gathering concentrates intention, wealth supplies stored means, and counting functions as preparing an inventory for a coming need. The hoard is therefore an imagined defense against contingency.

activation_trace.role: Concerted resolve supplies the purposeful planning that organizes the stockpile.
Possessed wealth supplies the reserve through which the plan expects to meet future need.
Readied equipment and stores recast the tally as prospective provisioning rather than retrospective arithmetic.

changed_reading.before: He counts what he already owns.
changed_reading.after: He inventories wealth as preparedness, treating stored means as protection against whatever may arrive.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The joined verbs around the same wealth-object permit counting to be a recurrent practice that preserves the collection's felt wholeness.
baseline_models.mechanism: A desire for an intact total requires recurrent return to the ledger. Enumeration does not finish possession; it periodically renews the assurance that nothing has scattered or gone missing.

activation_trace.role: Intact wholeness supplies the desired state that the repeated audit tries to preserve.
The acquired stock gives the recurring assurance ritual a material object.
Counted time and recurrence make the tally a returning practice rather than a single completed act.

changed_reading.before: Counting confirms a stable quantity once.
changed_reading.after: Counting is a recurring reassurance ritual by which the possessor repeatedly reconstructs the hoard as intact.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَالًا is gathered and then counted in a construction that can make the total meaningful relative to other totals, not solely in isolation.
baseline_models.mechanism: Wealth is assembled into a socially legible score: a collection becomes a count, and a count becomes a counterpart against which persons or shares can be compared.

activation_trace.role: An assembled group supplies the social field within which a total can acquire comparative force.
Acquired wealth supplies the measurable medium of distinction.
The counted counterpart turns quantity into a relation of comparison rather than a self-contained sum.

changed_reading.before: The total matters because it is large.
changed_reading.after: The total matters because it can rank its possessor against others and make social difference numerically legible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding universalized portrait of faulting and disparagement activates the comparative baseline: counted wealth becomes the score from which a person licenses a repeated social audit, finding defects and pushing others downward.

activation_trace.role: Accumulated property supplies the status-medium from which the subject evaluates others.
Counterpart comparison supplies the conversion from a private total to a relative social score.
Encompassing totality gives the hostile evaluation an indiscriminate scope.
Faulting and attacking people supplies the social use to which the wealth-score is put.
A disparaging push supplies the downward vector produced by the ranking.

structural_cues: The relative الَّذِي in 104:2 identifies the condemned type of 104:1 through the two wealth-actions.
The paired agent nouns in 104:1 make repetition in conduct salient before the intensive counting verb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies totalizing disparagement, comparative counting, and wealth; I infer that the wealth-count is the metric enabling the social attack. A live alternative is that the two behaviors merely coexist as traits without a causal arrow.

changed_reading.before: Wealth is a score by which the possessor privately locates himself among peers.
changed_reading.after: The ledger becomes a social ranking machine: it furnishes the superiority from which he repeatedly detects and presses down supposed defects in others.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context's pressure and pushing images materialize a shared force: property is pressed inward into a concentrated holding, while the same possessive force travels outward as verbal or social jabbing.

activation_trace.role: Consolidating scattered parts supplies the inward compression of assets.
Manual squeezing makes the gathering operation legible as pressure rather than neutral collection.
Pushing redirects the same pressure outward onto other people.

structural_cues: 104:1 places two parallel forms of interpersonal attack immediately before the relative clause of accumulation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward gathering, squeezing, and pushing; I supply the claim that one pressure-pattern links property practice to social conduct. The alternative is to keep the physical branch images unrelated to the surface social senses.

changed_reading.before: Gathering wealth is spatially neutral accumulation.
changed_reading.after: Accumulation has a pressure signature: it compresses value inward and reappears as pressure exerted outward on people.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated wealth-object links tallying to reckoning, while the shift within ح س ب from calculation to supposition exposes a cognitive slide: a measurable total is silently promoted into evidence that wealth can cause enduring existence.

activation_trace.role: Enumeration supplies the apparently objective procedure from which certainty is generated.
Calculation echoes the focus tally and carries its arithmetic into the following cognition.
Supposition marks the point where a count becomes an unproved belief.
The repeated wealth term keeps the same stock at the center of both arithmetic and belief.
Durable remaining supplies the impossible outcome inferred from finite property.

structural_cues: The object pronouns in عَدَّدَهُ and مَالَهُ/أَخْلَدَهُ make a tight chain from tally to wealth to imagined effect.
104:3 follows the counting clause without an intervening scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enumeration, the calculation/supposition branch pair, repeated wealth, and lasting; I infer a feedback arrow from repeated tally to causal conviction. The live alternative is that the belief in permanence is independent of the act of counting.

changed_reading.before: Counting records a quantity already possessed.
changed_reading.after: Counting manufactures conviction: the clarity of the number is misread as proof that finite wealth can secure enduring life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prepared reserve is no longer merely prudent provision. Activated by sufficiency and lasting attachment, it becomes an attempted substitute for dependence: enough stored means are imagined to answer even decay.

activation_trace.role: Prepared stores supply the baseline strategy of meeting future need in advance.
Sufficiency and enrichment turn preparedness into a claim of needing nothing beyond the reserve.
Durable remaining extends the imagined coverage of the reserve from ordinary need to mortality itself.

structural_cues: The explicit causal syntax أَنَّ مَالَهُ أَخْلَدَهُ places wealth in the subject-position of the imagined effect.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prepared stores, sufficiency, and lasting; I infer that provisioning has expanded into existential self-sufficiency. The alternative is a narrower wish for long reputation or long worldly security.

changed_reading.before: The stockpile is a practical buffer against foreseeable need.
changed_reading.after: The stockpile is treated as exhaustive sufficiency, a reserve expected to answer the unforeseeable limit of death.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's two control operations are reversed in order and agency: the gatherer is himself cast away, and the intact stock he tried to preserve is re-imaged through crushing and the debris of a passing world.

activation_trace.role: Gathering scattered parts supplies the constructive motion that the context overturns.
Intactness supplies the preserved state specifically undone by crushing.
Casting away reverses the gatherer's inward motion and turns the acting subject into a handled object.
Breaking a dry thing into fragments reverses the focus's production of a collected whole.
The debris of transient worldly goods projects the wealth itself toward its terminal material state.

structural_cues: The emphatic passive لَيُنْبَذَنَّ changes the focus's active accumulator into the object of an external action.
فِي introduces a destination whose name is an intensive breaking image.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering versus casting and intactness versus crushing; I infer a deliberate operation-by-operation reversal and extend the debris image to the hoard. The alternative is that only the person, not his wealth-practice, is reversed.

changed_reading.before: He gathers fragments into a durable, countable whole.
changed_reading.after: His gathering already contains its counter-motion: the gatherer will be thrown, and the whole he secured is read forward as breakable debris.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ledger offers mastery by finite enumeration, but the interrogative appeal to knowledge opens an object that defeats that mastery. The one who makes wealth knowable by counting meets a crushing process whose identity must be disclosed from beyond his account.

activation_trace.role: Enumeration supplies the subject's model of knowledge as exhaustive inventory.
The non-dominant mapped knowledge branch supplies the explicit epistemic challenge to that inventory model.
Fragmentation supplies an object whose action undoes the stable units on which exhaustive counting depends.

structural_cues: The repeated مَا in 104:5 suspends identification before naming the same crushing term again.
The formula addresses a limit of the addressee's unaided knowing immediately after the accumulator's self-assured reckoning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enumeration, explicit knowing, and fragmentation; I infer that the knowledge-question counter-audits the subject's faith in countability. The alternative is that the formula magnifies punishment without commenting on his epistemic habit.

changed_reading.before: To count is to make what matters fully knowable.
changed_reading.after: The focus ledger becomes an epistemic foil: its finite mastery is confronted by a reality it cannot identify, bound, or neutralize through number.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preparedness reading is materially inverted. What was assembled and inventoried as reserve is reclassified as combustible supply; accumulation does not starve the coming event but stocks what its fire consumes.

activation_trace.role: Accumulated property supplies the reserve whose function is reclassified.
Prepared stores supply the stockpile logic that makes the fuel reversal exact.
Kindled fire supplies the consuming process opposed to preservation.
Fuel material converts the idea of stored means into stored combustibility.
Active ignition supplies the arrow by which reserve becomes expenditure.

structural_cues: The nominal identification نَارُ اللَّهِ is followed by a passive participle of sustained ignition.
The fire specification immediately unfolds the previously named crusher.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a prepared wealth-reserve, fire, fuel, and ignition; I infer that the hoard is analogically recoded as combustible inventory. The alternative is that wealth and fuel remain separate and only the person is consumed.

changed_reading.before: Counted wealth is stored capacity reserved against loss.
changed_reading.after: The reserve is combustible capacity: every secured unit can be reread as another unit of fuel for the process meant to defeat security.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated counting concentrates attention around wealth until the ledger resembles a private devotional practice. The divine attribution of the ignited fire then contests not merely an asset but the orientation of repeated reliance toward that asset.

activation_trace.role: Possessed wealth supplies the object around which attention and reliance gather.
Timed recurrence supplies the repeated observance-like quality of the count.
Worship and its object supply the category by which recurrent attention can be tested as ultimate orientation.
Ignition supplies the decisive displacement of the wealth-centered practice.

structural_cues: The focus gives two successive acts to wealth, while 104:6 gives the fire an explicit divine attribution.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrent counting, wealth, worship, and divinely attributed ignition; I infer a ritual analogy between repeated attention and devotion. A live alternative is a judicial contrast with no claim that counting itself has liturgical form.

changed_reading.before: Counting is an administrative habit directed at property.
changed_reading.after: Counting can be carried as a private liturgy of reliance, with wealth functioning as the recurrent center that the later divine fire displaces.

context_deltas.mechanism: The direction of inspection reverses. The subject surveys external units and imagines control; the context supplies an exposing ascent that reaches the inner heart, making the counter-audit penetrate the auditor rather than his property.

activation_trace.role: Enumeration supplies the outward audit performed on discrete possessions.
Surveying and disclosure reverse who inspects whom and open what the ledger cannot see.
The heart conceived through internal ignition supplies the hidden interior reached by the counter-audit.

structural_cues: The relative الَّتِي gives the fire an active penetrating predicate.
عَلَى moves the action onto the hearts after the focus subject acted upon wealth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies external enumeration, disclosure/survey, and an inwardly heated heart; I infer an audit reversal from possessions to possessor. The alternative is purely spatial penetration without an epistemic answer to counting.

changed_reading.before: The subject is the knowing auditor and wealth is the inspected object.
changed_reading.after: His ledger is answered by an inward audit: the apparent observer becomes the exposed object, and the uncounted center of valuation is reached.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recurrent tallying joins repeated looking and inward ignition. Each review intended to certify enough instead renews desire, so the count is a positive-feedback loop that makes the hoard psychologically unfinished.

activation_trace.role: Accumulated wealth supplies the repeatedly viewed stimulus.
Recurrence supplies the repeated return through which desire can feed itself.
Aspiration and much looking convert visual review into renewed appetite.
Internal ignition supplies the affective heat generated by the repeated gaze.

structural_cues: The focus's intensive counting action and the context's imperfect penetrating action both resist a single completed event.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrent count, acquisitive wealth, repeated looking/desire, and inward heat; I infer a feedback arrow in which checking renews wanting. The alternative is that the heart-fire is only punitive and says nothing about the psychology of counting.

changed_reading.before: Counting closes the account by confirming that the stock is enough.
changed_reading.after: Every recount reopens the account: looking at the total reheats desire and makes possession feel incomplete.

context_deltas.mechanism: The split inventory supplies both sealed enclosure and, unusually, a stone cache for wealth. Those branches activate an inside-out reversal: gathering and counting build the conceptual vault, but the hoarder ends up on the inside of the security architecture.

activation_trace.role: Consolidation supplies the act of bringing valuables into one bounded holding.
Property supplies the content for which a secure cache would be built.
Inventory supplies the access-and-control practice associated with the imagined vault.
Complete closure supplies the terminal state in which exit and control are removed.
The non-dominant stone wealth-cache branch makes the vault analogy materially specific rather than generic enclosure.

structural_cues: عَلَيْهِم places the sealed condition over and around the plural objects.
The passive result-state مُؤْصَدَةٌ removes the accumulator's former agency over containment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathered wealth, inventory, sealed enclosure, and a stone cache for wealth; I supply the inside-out arrow by which the protective vault becomes the possessor's prison. The live alternative is ordinary confinement with no echo of hoarding architecture.

changed_reading.before: Gathering and counting place wealth safely inside a controlled store.
changed_reading.after: The focus actions prefigure a vault whose logic turns inside out: the architecture made to enclose wealth closes over the wealth-counter himself.

context_deltas.mechanism: Discrete additions to the hoard become modular construction. Gathering joins units, counting supplies repeatable modules, and extended supports materialize that additive logic as an architecture of confinement.

activation_trace.role: Joining separate parts supplies the assembly operation from which a structure can be built.
Counted units supply repeatable modules for the imagined construction.
Columns and supports give the accumulated modules an enclosing architectural form.
Drawing connected material out in length turns addition into extended bars or supports.
Continuous supplementation supplies the open-ended addition by which the structure keeps extending.

structural_cues: The final prepositional phrase locates the enclosed subjects within plural supports qualified by extension.
The focus's serial verbs and the ending's noun-plus-adjective both stage assembly followed by expansion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies joined parts, countable units, columns, lengthening, and supplementation; I infer that repeated accumulation builds the confinement module by module. The alternative is literal punishment architecture unrelated to the ledger's additive form.

changed_reading.before: Each counted unit adds to the owner's security.
changed_reading.after: Each counted unit is also an imagined building unit: the additive ledger extends the bars of the enclosure it promised to prevent.

context_deltas.mechanism: A cross-domain hydraulic reading emerges: wealth is treated as a replenished flow, while gathering arrests that flow behind a deliberate obstruction. The count measures a reservoir produced by stopped circulation, not value newly created.

activation_trace.role: Collection from scattered sources supplies the convergence of a flow into one reservoir.
Property supplies the economic substance transferred into the hydraulic analogy.
Blocking a flood-channel supplies the obstruction that converts circulation into hoarded pressure.
Running water replenished by other water supplies the model of value sustained through circulation.

structural_cues: The final pair combines a support-root with an extension-root, allowing both architectural and hydraulic mechanisms to coexist.
The focus moves from convergence to a repeated measure, the same sequence by which a reservoir becomes legible.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies collection, wealth, a dammed watercourse, and replenished running water; I transfer the flow relation to wealth and infer that hoarding interrupts circulation. The literal extended-column reading remains fully live and should not be merged with this analogy.

changed_reading.before: The hoard is simply more wealth brought under one ownership.
changed_reading.after: The hoard is a dammed circulation: its impressive measured level may register how much flow has been arrested and how much pressure the obstruction creates.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recurrent counted intervals are joined to both imagined permanence and actual extension. This distinguishes duration from immortality: the ledger can keep adding finite terms, but endless addition only simulates the qualitative state the subject attributes to wealth.

activation_trace.role: Counted recurrence supplies the sequence of finite intervals that can feel indefinitely renewable.
Lasting without rapid decay supplies the qualitatively different state falsely inferred from the sequence.
A lengthened term supplies real extension while preserving its finitude.

structural_cues: The surah moves from repeated counting through a claim of lasting to a closing adjective of extension.
The indefinite مَالًا contrasts with the definite personal claim مَالَهُ and then with an extended terminal state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrent counted time, lasting, and an extended term; I infer that additive duration is being mistaken for permanence. The alternative is that the final extension concerns only spatial columns and does not reactivate time.

changed_reading.before: Recounting wealth reassures the subject that security can be renewed without limit.
changed_reading.after: Recounting manufactures a counterfeit eternity by adding finite intervals; the later extension exposes duration as prolonged yet still imposed and bounded.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The bodily image is surprising because جَمَعَ does not lexically mean clenching here, yet the focus inventory explicitly supplies the gathered palm and the count remains directly anchored in عَدَّدَهُ. Carry this only as a tactile material analogy: the hoard is mentally reduced to graspable palmfuls, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The adjacent gathering, wealth, and counting operations permit a bodily picture of possession as grasp plus tactile enumeration.

activation_trace.role: The closed palm supplies a bodily model of possession as gripping and containing.
Wealth supplies what the imagined grip tries to retain.
Enumeration breaks the mass into mentally handled units, like repeated palmfuls.

changed_reading.before: The hoard is an abstract financial total.
changed_reading.after: The hoard acquires a bodily posture: value is repeatedly gathered into an imagined fist and handled unit by unit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the rare م و ل inventory item is a spider term, and the web/trap relation is reader-supplied rather than stated. It remains anchored in the focus wealth-root and is sharpened by the later sealed enclosure; render it explicitly as an exploratory web analogy, never as the lexical meaning of مَالًا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مَالًا is the gathered center of the focus clause, while the context later closes an enclosure over its possessors.

activation_trace.role: The rare spider branch supplies the living source for a web-like material analogy around wealth.
Drawing scattered material into one construction supplies the web's aggregating action.
Sealed closure converts the constructed network from shelter into trap.

changed_reading.before: Wealth is inert material placed in a secure container.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, wealth is a web-like construction: the possessor gathers it strand by strand until his own security-system closes as a trap.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The spinning and whirlpool images come from the dominant د ر ر target in a split mapping for أَدْرَىٰ, so they are deliberately form-distant and must not gloss the surface verb. They remain worth carrying because recurrent counting is a direct focus branch and the context packet explicitly preserves this mapped target; qualify the result as a kinetic analogy for a self-repeating ledger.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The recurrent branch of عَدَّدَهُ allows the count itself to be modeled as circular motion that fails to advance toward knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Timed recurrence supplies the repeated return of the counting cycle.
A spindle's tightened rotation supplies an image of disciplined repetition that remains in place.
A water-whirlpool supplies the more dangerous alternative in which repeated motion draws the counter inward.

changed_reading.before: Each recount advances knowledge by refreshing the total.
changed_reading.after: The ledger can spin like a spindle or whirlpool: intense recurrence gives the sensation of disciplined motion while returning to the same point and drawing its user inward.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The vessel image is surprising because it activates a specialized ن ب ذ branch rather than the ordinary act of casting, and the processor relation is abductive. It remains anchored by the focus's consolidation operation, the passive casting into فِي, and the crusher's consuming branch; render it as a contained material reversal, not a literal claim about a beverage vessel.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The one who gathers wealth into a bounded stock is later passively cast into a bounded destination.

activation_trace.role: Consolidation supplies the focus subject's original act of placing many items into one holding.
Material cast into a vessel supplies the reversal in which the accumulator becomes deposited content.
A consuming, digesting force supplies the vessel's function as processor rather than store.

changed_reading.before: The subject is the container-maker who deposits and inventories valuables.
changed_reading.after: The agency inverts: he becomes the deposited item inside a consuming processor, handled as completely as he handled his stock.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The overshooting projectile is remote from the surface sense of تَطَّلِعُ, but it is a packet branch and it couples visibly to the focus's preparedness and tally. Preserve it only as a diagnostic analogy: no attained number can function as the target that finally ends accumulation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عَدَّدَهُ can make the desired total into a moving target because every achieved inventory permits another increment.

activation_trace.role: Prepared stores supply the initial finite target of having enough for what may come.
A projectile rising beyond its target supplies the image of accumulation passing every proposed sufficiency threshold.
Aspiration and repeated looking explain why the target moves after each count reaches it.

changed_reading.before: Counting measures progress toward a determinate amount of security.
changed_reading.after: Counting abolishes the stopping number: each reached target is overshot because the act of checking generates a farther target.

strongest_changes: Enumeration becomes a cognitive engine that converts exact quantity into the unsupported belief that wealth causes lasting.
The focus operations undergo paired reversals: gathering becomes casting, intactness becomes crushing, and reserve becomes fuel.
The split و ص د inventory makes the wealth-vault turn into the possessor's sealed prison.
The outward audit of possessions is answered by an inward exposure of the heart.
The final support and extension branches preserve both an architectural reading in which counted units build bars and a hydraulic reading in which hoarding dams circulation.
summary.what_was_special: The focus is not only a portrait of greed but a compact machine whose own operations are re-used against it. Gathering, inventory, preparedness, comparison, recurrence, and enclosure remain simultaneous readings; context successively turns those same operations into social pressure, false inference, fragmentation, combustion, inward audit, and self-built confinement. The most packet-specific surprise is the non-dominant stone wealth-cache branch under و ص د, which makes the vault-to-prison inversion unusually exact.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal arrow from counting wealth to disparaging people is coherent but the context can also present independent traits of one person.
عَدَّدَهُ supports enumeration most directly; preparedness, recurrence, and counterpart comparison are live branch activations rather than exclusive lexical resolutions.
The hydraulic circulation model is cross-domain and must coexist with the more immediate extended-column architecture.
Spider, vessel, spindle, whirlpool, and overshooting images are valid packet activations but remain deliberately contained material analogies, not proposed surface translations.
The temporal reading of مُمَدَّدَةٍ remains live beside its spatial modification of عَمَدٍ and should not displace it.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Hoarded parts become prison-architecture.** Evidence: `ج م ع B001` (gathering scattered parts into one whole), `م و ل B001` (wealth/property), and `ع د د B001` (enumerating), activated by `ع م د B003` and `م د د B001` in 104:9. Structural cue: gathered and counted units precede extended structural units. Assigned role: gathering/counting turns wealth into an ordered aggregate. Abductive move: what the hoarder assembles for possession can be reassembled by the text as the material logic of confinement. Reading change: the ayah is not only about accumulation; it begins constructing the later prison out of counted units.

2. **Counting as preparation against a coming need.** Evidence: `ع د د B002` (preparing equipment, stores, wealth, arms) alongside `م و ل B001`, activated by `خ ل د B001` in 104:3 and `م د د B004` in 104:9. Structural cue: "collected and counted it" is followed immediately by the thought that wealth has made him endure. Assigned role: counting functions as readiness for future vulnerability. Abductive move: he counts because he imagines a stored reserve can answer time, death, or exposure. Reading change: the ayah reads as anxious provisioning, not mere greed.

3. **The clenched hand behind wealth and insult.** Evidence: `ج م ع B005` (clenched hollow of the hand), activated by `ه م ز B001` (pressing/squeezing) and `ن ب ذ B001` (casting from the hand). Structural cue: bodily pressure links speech, gathering, and later throwing. Assigned role: the hand-image turns accumulation into grip. Abductive move: the same contracted posture that holds wealth also presses others and will finally be forced open in casting. Reading change: collecting money becomes a bodily stance of contraction.

4. **Restraint latent inside accumulation.** Evidence: `ج م ع B008` (restraint gathering hands to neck), activated by `و ص د B001` and `ع م د B003`. Structural cue: gathered possession moves toward immobilizing enclosure. Assigned role: جمع supplies the hidden shackle-image inside collection. Abductive move: when possession becomes the organizing principle, gathered things also gather the possessor into bonds. Reading change: the wealth is already a restraint before explicit punishment arrives.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 104:4 reversed the whole ayah: the one who gathered is himself نبذ. 104:8-9 made the strongest later surprise: counted wealth no longer looks inert but architectural, as if enumeration trains the form of sealed, extended confinement.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Counting as a machine for manufacturing permanence.** Fixed `جَمَعَ` realizes `ج م ع B001` (collecting scattered parts into one whole), fixed `مَالًا` realizes `م و ل B001` (acquired wealth), and fixed `عَدَّدَهُ` realizes `ع د د B001` (enumeration). `104:3` adds `ح س ب B001` (reckoning), `ح س ب B002` (supposition), and `خ ل د B001` (enduring permanence). The packet supplies the exact chain gather, count, reckon, permanence; I infer the causal arrow by which repeated enumeration turns a stock into apparent evidence of endless duration. The ayah therefore reads as the construction of a false predictive model, not only as possession plus a repetitive habit.

2. **The hoard as defensive equipment.** Fixed `ع د د B002` supplies preparing equipment, stores, arms, or wealth for a coming need. That latent branch is activated by the abrupt corrective and emphatic passive casting in `104:4`, `ن ب ذ B001`. The packet gives stored wealth followed by an event for which it proves useless; I infer that the counting also functions as rehearsal and provisioning against contingency. `وَعَدَّدَهُ` can thus read as an attempt to make wealth ready as protection, with the next movement exposing the reserve's inability to block reversal.

3. **Exploratory closed-hand accumulation becoming fuel.** Alongside fixed `ج م ع B001`, `ج م ع B005` images the clenched hollow of the hand; it is activated backward by the squeezing image of `ه م ز B001` in `104:1` and forward by `و ق د B002` in `104:6`, material consumed as fuel. The packet supplies pressure, gathering, wealth, and a kindled fire, but it never states that the wealth is fuel; that conversion is my inference. The fixed act of gathering can therefore be read materially as a closed-handed compression that stockpiles what will feed, rather than prevent, the consuming mechanism. This reading is exploratory because the fuel identity is structurally suggested rather than grammatically asserted.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: `104:3` confirmed that enumeration feeds a mental reckoning, but `104:6`-`104:7` supplied the less expected correction: the trajectory ends in kindling and an inner-kindling heart, not in an external balance sheet. This strengthened the reading of counting as a whole permanence-producing economy. It also left the closed-hand-to-fuel reading explicitly exploratory, since the later ayat provide a fuel slot and inward endpoint but never identify wealth itself as the fuel.

findings.text: Toplama ve sayma zinciri, sınırlı bir servet toplamını kalıcılık kanıtı gibi gösteren yanlış bir hesap düzeni üretir.
Serveti saymak, gelecekteki ihtiyaç ve tehlikelere karşı onu hazır bir savunma donanımı gibi tutma kaygısını da açığa çıkarır.
Toplanıp sayılan parçalar, son ayetlerdeki uzatılmış ve düzenli kapatma yapısının maddi mantığını önceden kurar.
Toplama eylemi, serveti sımsıkı tutan kapalı bir el duruşuna dönüşür; daha sonra toplayanın kendisinin atılması bu tutuşu tersine çevirir.
Kapalı elle biriktirilen servetin, güvenlik sağlayan stok değil, sonraki ateşi besleyebilecek tüketilir bir birikim olduğu ileri sürülür.
Biriktirme, sahibine özgürlük vermek yerine onu kendi malına bağlayan gizli bir kısıtlama biçimine dönüşür.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same force pattern extends through compressed articulation, a clenched palm, a prod or bow impulse, a charging mass, and an exhausted driven animal.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Crushing by Coalesced Mass
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Separate bodies gather momentum, overrun what lies before them, and leave brittle matter fragmented.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: brittle fracture and fragmentation (`ح ط م:B001/m01`); trampling herd or ravaging mass (`ح ط م:B006/m01`); coalesced charging force (`ج م ع:B010/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Crushing is not only a single impact. It can be the cumulative force of a herd, flood-like movement, or gathered charge whose parts become one destructive mass and reduce resistant material to fragments.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Gathered quantities are counted, provisioned, extended, and treated as though numerical control could secure adequacy or duration.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Quantity expands into total capacity, reserve logistics, calendrical spans, devotional fixation on property, and the return of worldly goods to breakable debris.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Hoarding, Calculation, and False Permanence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Property is gathered and repeatedly counted, then mentally promoted from a reserve into a guarantor of lasting existence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: gathering dispersed holdings (`ج م ع:B001/m01`); numerical enumeration (`ع د د:B001/m01`); accumulated property (`م و ل:B001/m01`); accounting and calculation (`ح س ب:B001/m01`); supposition (`ح س ب:B002/m01`); enduring permanence (`خ ل د:B001/m01`); devotion and object-making (`ء ل ه:B001/m01`); transient worldly goods (`ح ط م:B009/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 104:2 جَمَعَ (`ج م ع`), مَالًا (`م و ل`), and عَدَّدَهُ (`ع د د`); 104:3 يَحْسَبُ (`ح س ب`), مَالَهُ (`م و ل`), and أَخْلَدَهُ (`خ ل د`); 104:4-5 ٱلْحُطَمَةِ/ٱلْحُطَمَةُ (`ح ط م`); 104:6 ٱللَّهِ (`ء ل ه`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Counting converts possessions into an apparently closed system of security. The devotional branch sharpens the relation: wealth can be treated as an object of ultimate reliance, yet the crushing branch recasts its display and ornament as passing debris.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Gathered quantities are counted, provisioned, extended, and treated as though numerical control could secure adequacy or duration.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Quantity expands into total capacity, reserve logistics, calendrical spans, devotional fixation on property, and the return of worldly goods to breakable debris.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Totality and Full Capacity
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Parts are enclosed in a whole until nothing appears absent and the containing space is filled to capacity.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: complete and undiminished whole (`ج م ع:B009/m01`); all-inclusive totality (`ك ل ل:B003/m01`); capacity filled to its limit (`ط ل ع:B007/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Gathering reaches a terminal state in which the object is intact, the parts are comprehensively included, and the available space is full. The channel turns counting from an open sequence into bounded completeness.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Gathered quantities are counted, provisioned, extended, and treated as though numerical control could secure adequacy or duration.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Prepared Reserves and Material Aid
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Supplies are measured, stored, and made ready so they can sustain a person, household, or force when need arrives.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: prepared equipment and reserves (`ع د د:B002/m01`); reinforcements and material aid (`م د د:B002/m01`); sufficient provision (`ح س ب:B003/m01`); measured allotment (`م د د:B006/m01`); small residual portion (`ن ب ذ:B005/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Enumeration becomes logistics: one prepares an outfit, reserve, weapon, food supply, or reinforcement, then portions it by measure. The tiny remainder and the sufficient store establish the lower and upper bounds of usable provision.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Gathered quantities are counted, provisioned, extended, and treated as though numerical control could secure adequacy or duration.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Quantity expands into total capacity, reserve logistics, calendrical spans, devotional fixation on property, and the return of worldly goods to breakable debris.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Counted Terms and Recurring Time
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Time is divided into obligatory intervals, recurring appointments, and prolonged terms.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: prescribed waiting span (`ع د د:B003/m01`); recurrent appointed time (`ع د د:B005/m01`); extended term or respite (`م د د:B004/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Numbering governs duration as well as possessions. A span can be counted because it imposes waiting, returns on schedule, or is deliberately prolonged, making time itself an administered quantity.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Material is fed into heat, transformed by combustion or digestion, and carried from an external fire into bodily and emotional interiors.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The fire scene includes fuel, hearth, cooking vessel, digestive action, inward anger, appetite, vomiting, summer heat, and drought.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Ignition, Fuel, Hearth, and Cooking
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Fuel is placed at a hearth, rapidly ignited, and used to heat, roast, or bake food before digestion completes the transformation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: ignition and flame (`و ق د:B001/m01`); combustible fuel (`و ق د:B002/m01`); hearth or fire-place (`و ق د:B003/m01`); rapid kindling (`و ق د:B005/m01`); visible fire (`ن و ر:B002/m01`); heat and fire (`ف ء د:B001/m01`); roasting or baking (`ف ء د:B001/m02`); hearth and skewer implements (`ف ء د:B001/m03`); large cooking vessel (`ج م ع:B012/m01`); digestive action (`ح ط م:B008/m02`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 104:2 جَمَعَ (`ج م ع`); 104:4-5 ٱلْحُطَمَةِ/ٱلْحُطَمَةُ (`ح ط م`); 104:6 نَارُ (`ن و ر`) and ٱلْمُوقَدَةُ (`و ق د`); 104:7 ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ (`ف ء د`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The lexical branches assemble a complete combustion system: material fuel, a bounded hearth, ignition, flame, vessel, food, and digestive breakdown. External fire and internal digestion become parallel mechanisms for reducing and transforming matter.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Space is bounded by doors, yards, pens, covers, restraints, walls, and load-bearing members that determine what remains inside and what can stand.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The closed structure ranges from a sealed doorway to a mountain livestock pen, a bodily canopy, a hand-to-neck fetter, and a crowded sanctuary.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Canopy and Bodily Restraint
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Flexible enclosure surrounds a body either protectively as a canopy or coercively as a fetter.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: tent-like protective cover (`ك ل ل:B006/m01`); hand-to-neck restraint (`ج م ع:B008/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Both objects gather the body into a restricted volume. The canopy excludes insects and exposure, whereas the fetter removes freedom of movement, creating a sharp protective-versus-punitive reversal.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Space is bounded by doors, yards, pens, covers, restraints, walls, and load-bearing members that determine what remains inside and what can stand.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The closed structure ranges from a sealed doorway to a mountain livestock pen, a bodily canopy, a hand-to-neck fetter, and a crowded sanctuary.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Crowded Sacred Gathering Place
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: People converge at a sacred gathering place whose wall or precinct becomes compressed by crowding.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: crowded or broken sanctuary precinct (`ح ط م:B007/m01`); pilgrimage gathering place or day (`ج م ع:B004/m02`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Gathering supplies the human convergence, while the sanctuary branch gives it a built boundary vulnerable to pressure and breakage. Social assembly and architectural compression occupy one scene.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Individuals become a durable social body through assembly, alliance, rank, kinship, and reproductive connection.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Collective cohesion ranges from public assembly and strategic alliance to tent-based status, collateral inheritance, sexual union, pregnancy, and the suspended state of an unconsummated marriage.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Assembly and Alliance
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Dispersed people gather at a common place, become a recognized group, and coordinate around a shared undertaking.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: assembled group or mixed collective (`ج م ع:B002/m01`); civic gathering place or summons (`ج م ع:B004/m01`); alliance or collusion (`ج م ع:B013/m01`); grouped bodies (`ك ل ل:B009/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Collection becomes social organization when a place or summons brings people together and alliance gives the group a common direction. The resulting whole is more than proximity: its members act in concert.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Individuals become a durable social body through assembly, alliance, rank, kinship, and reproductive connection.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Collective cohesion ranges from public assembly and strategic alliance to tent-based status, collateral inheritance, sexual union, pregnancy, and the suspended state of an unconsummated marriage.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Tent Community and Comparative Standing
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A mobile tent community distinguishes households and persons by inherited standing, visible qualities, and comparison with peers.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: socially counted prestige (`ح س ب:B004/m01`); people of tents and poles (`ع م د:B004/m01`); peer, counterpart, or allotted share (`ع د د:B006/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The tent pole supplies a social setting as well as a structure. Within it, standing is something reckoned from ancestry, conduct, generosity, or wealth and negotiated by comparison with others.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Individuals become a durable social body through assembly, alliance, rank, kinship, and reproductive connection.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Collective cohesion ranges from public assembly and strategic alliance to tent-based status, collateral inheritance, sexual union, pregnancy, and the suspended state of an unconsummated marriage.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Union, Pregnancy, and Withheld Consummation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Sexual union creates reproductive continuity, while pregnancy, virginity, or an unconsummated marriage marks whether that connection has taken effect.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: sexual union (`ج م ع:B006/m01`); retained pregnancy (`ج م ع:B007/m01`); untouched spouse or virgin state (`ج م ع:B007/m02`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Gathering becomes the joining of bodies and the continuity of generations. The same lexical container also records suspended union: a spouse remains untouched, or pregnancy remains held within the body.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Something hidden or low comes into view by rising, sprouting, approaching, peeking, flashing, or occupying a vantage point.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The invariant links luminaries, beacons, lightning, palms, flowers, shy peeking, sudden arrival, mountain ascent, and conspicuous height.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Sprouting, Flowering, and Close-Rooted Growth
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Plants emerge from hidden growth, flower, and thicken into a closely rooted stand.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: emerging palm spathe or crop (`ط ل ع:B005/m01`); blossom (`ن و ر:B004/m01`); close-rooted vegetation (`و ص د:B004/m01`); mixed seed-grown date palm (`ج م ع:B011/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Emergence proceeds from first visible growth to flower and then to a dense stand whose roots draw near one another. The unnamed mixed palm adds generative variety to the same cultivated scene.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Knowledge is sought or assembled, converted into intention, and then directed toward governance, reconnaissance, hunting, conflict, or formal exchange.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Epistemic inquiry develops into administrative oversight, scouting, a concealed hunt, projectile mechanics, treaty renunciation, and sale by thrown token.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Deliberation and Accountable Leadership
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A group consolidates its judgment, an overseer examines conduct, and a relied-upon leader carries the decision.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: resolved collective judgment (`ج م ع:B003/m01`); practical oversight and accountability (`ح س ب:B006/m01`); relied-upon leader (`ع م د:B006/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Distributed opinions are gathered into resolve, oversight tests the resulting conduct, and leadership supplies the person on whom implementation rests. Cognition becomes administration.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A material moves through a channel or container to replenish, mix with, or extend another material system.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same replenishment mechanism governs rivers and wells, earth dams, steeped fruit drink, enriched animal water, and ink drawn from an inkwell into a pen.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Wells, Feeding Waters, and Earthworks
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Water collects in a durable source, one flow replenishes another, and a dam redirects or holds the current against packed earth.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: perennial well or collected water (`ع د د:B004/m01`); water feeding another watercourse (`م د د:B003/m01`); dam across a stream (`ع م د:B013/m01`); rain-packed soil (`ع م د:B010/m01`); loose excavated earth (`ن ب ذ:B009/m02`); coalesced flood momentum (`ج م ع:B010/m02`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 104:2 جَمَعَ (`ج م ع`) and عَدَّدَهُ (`ع د د`); 104:4 يُنۢبَذَ (`ن ب ذ`); 104:9 عَمَدٍ (`ع م د`) and مُّمَدَّدَةٍ (`م د د`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The channel supplies source, flow, barrier, and construction material. Water gathers and extends itself through tributary feeding, while packed and excavated earth reshape that movement into a retained pool or redirected course.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Bodies move between intact strength and loss of integrity through pain, heart disease, aging, pressure wounds, suppuration, or altered skin.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The body appears as chest and heart, aged mount, swollen saddle wound, vigorous youth, intact animal, and skin whose color shades into disease.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Vigor and Undiminished Form
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A youthful or stout body retains fullness, strength, and all of its parts.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: vigorous full-bodied youth (`ع م د:B011/m01`); stout compact physique (`ك ل ل:B008/m01`); intact body without loss (`ج م ع:B009/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Integrity is rendered positively as compact strength, bodily fullness, and the absence of missing parts. This is the bodily opposite of the crushed, emaciated, or suppurating state.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A visible surface is dressed, encircled, groomed, colored, marked, or made to flash.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Presentation includes a child's undergarment, earrings and bracelets, combing, kohl, depilation, tattoo smoke, livestock branding, crowns, smiles, and gemstone-like sparkle.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Garment and Attached Jewelry
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Clothing covers the body while ornaments remain attached at the ear or wrist as durable visible additions.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: small undergarment (`ء ص د:B003/m01`); attached earrings or bracelets (`خ ل د:B003/m01`); garments gathered over the body (`ج م ع:B009/m02`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 104:2 جَمَعَ (`ج م ع`); 104:3 أَخْلَدَهُ (`خ ل د`); no separate surface occurrence for `ء ص د`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Covering and attachment form two layers of presentation. Garments gather around the body, while jewelry remains fixed to selected points and turns persistence into ornament.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi parmaklar kapanınca oluşan sıkılmış avucu, onunla vurmayı ve avuç miktarını aynı somut biçim çevresinde toplar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Sıkılmış avuç çekirdeği ile avuç dolusu miktar ve bu avuçla vurma kullanımları birbirinden açıkça ayrılır.

facets.statement: Parmakların kapanmasıyla el sıkılmış bir avuç biçimi alır ve bu biçimle vurulabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım sıkılmış avucu temel alır; bu avuçla vurmayı ve avucun doldurduğu para ya da meyve miktarını aynı biçime bağlar.

concept_gloss.text: sıkılmış avuç veya bir avuçluk miktar

error_profile.preserves: Kapalı avuç biçimini ve bu biçimden doğan ölçü değerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Meyve, para veya benzeri bir şeyin avucun alacağı miktarı anlatırken kullanılır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: sıkılmış avuç veya bu avuçla vurma

concept_gloss.applicability: Kadınla erkek arasındaki cinsel birleşmenin doğrudan veya örtülü biçimde anlatıldığı kullanımları karşılar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, genel varlık ve varlık edinme çekirdeğini ayrı tutar; göçebe toplulukların hayvan sürülerini varlık sayan kullanımını yalnızca belirli bir söz öbeğine bağlı özelleşme olarak sınırlar.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin sahip olduğu değerli varlıkların bütünü ile bunları edinme, çoğaltma ya da bunlara sahip duruma gelme alanıdır. Ayrıca başkasını varlık sahibi kılmayı kapsar; göçebe topluluklara özgü kullanımda sahip olunan varlık özellikle hayvan sürüleridir.

facets.statement: Kişinin sahip olduğu ve değer taşıyan varlıkların bütünü bu dalın ad çekirdeğini oluşturur.
Göçebe toplulukların varlığına ilişkin belirli kullanımda bu varlık, hayvan sürüleriyle somutlaşır.
Kişinin kendisi için değerli varlık edinmesi ve onu kalıcı sahiplik konusu yapması eylem çekirdeğidir.
Kişinin varlığının çoğalması ya da onun varlık sahibi bir duruma geçmesi ayrı bir süreç görünümüdür.
Bir başkasına değerli varlık vererek onu varlık sahibi duruma getirmek, çekirdeğin ettirgen uzantısıdır.
Bir kimsenin varlığının çokluğuna şaşma bildiren söyleyiş, artış ve bolluk görünümüne bağlı bir kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların toplu anlatımı, sahip olunan değerli varlıkları ve bunların çoğulunu temel alır; varlık edinme, varlığın çoğalması, varlıklı duruma gelme ve başkasını varlık sahibi kılma süreçlerini bu temel çevresinde birleştirir. Hayvan sürüleri göçebe topluluklara özgü somutlaşma, çokluk karşısındaki şaşma söyleyişi ise bağlı bir kullanım olarak aktarılır. Mal adının küçültme biçimi de ayrıca kaydedilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözcüğü örümceğe verilen bir ad olarak aktarır, fakat aynı ifadenin içinde bu aktarımın kuşkuyla karşılandığını ve güvenilir bir aktarıcıdan işitilmediğini de açıkça bildirir. Bu nedenle hayvanla kurulan bağ korunabilir, ancak yerleşik ve tartışmasız bir ad gibi sunulamaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, örümceğin özelliklerini tanımlamaz; yalnızca örümcek için aktarılan ve güvenilirliği açıkça tartışılan bir adlandırmayı temsil eder.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kanıt, bu tartışmalı adlandırmanın bağımsız ve yerleşik bir yalın sözlük birimi olup olmadığını mekanik olarak çözmez; tanım bu yüzden yalın kullanım varsaymaz.

concept_map.definition: Örümceğe verilen bir ad olarak aktarılır; ancak bu adlandırmanın güvenilirliği kaynak anlatımının kendi içinde açıkça tartışmalıdır.

facets.statement: Sözcük, bazı sözlük aktarımlarında örümceği gösteren bir hayvan adı olarak verilir.
Adlandırmanın doğruluğu ve güvenilir aktarımı açıkça sorgulandığı için bu gönderim kesin kabul edilemez.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak kaydı sözcüğü örümceğin adı olarak aktarır, fakat aynı kayıtta bu eşleştirmenin kuşkulu olduğu ve güvenilir bir kaynaktan işitilmediği yönünde açık çekinceler bulunur. Bu yüzden hayvana gönderim ile aktarımın belirsizliği birlikte korunmalıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sözcüğün örümceğe gönderimi aktarılırken bu adlandırmanın güvenilirliğine ilişkin açık kuşkunun da korunması gereken her durumda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Adlandırmanın gönderimde bulunduğu hayvanı doğru biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Bu adlandırmanın güvenilirliği ve yerleşikliği üzerindeki açık kaynak kuşkusunu görünmez kılar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yalnızca kuşkulu hayvan adı aktarımıyla sınırlıdır; komşu dalın kendi ayrı adı ve yuvayı gösteren bağlı kullanımı vardır. Bu ek kapsam ve odaktaki güvenilirlik çekincesi tam eşdeğerliği engeller.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnızca zorunlu bir bekleme süresini değil, kadın için ölçülen bekleme dönemini, kaçırılan günler kadar sonradan yerine getirme süresini ve belirli sayıda günleri birlikte içerir. lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, sayılı süre çekirdeğini korurken kadınla ilgili bekleme, kaçırılan günleri tamamlama ve belirli günler kalıplarını ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Sayısı veya bitiş ölçütü belirlenmiş bir zaman dilimidir. Bağlama göre bu dilim kadın için bekleme süresi, kaçırılan günler kadar sonradan yerine getirme süresi ya da özellikle belirlenmiş sınırlı günler olabilir.

facets.statement: Gün, ay, dönemsel çevrim veya olay sonuyla ölçülüp sınırlandırılmış zaman dilimi.
Bir kadının belirli çevrimler, aylar veya gebeliğin sona ermesiyle ölçülen bekleme süresi.

word_morpheme_spans.note: Accepted bridge links preserve independent analysis identities. Several analysis entries may share canonical morphemes. Read their distinct semantic claims; shared morphology alone is not duplication. Legacy aligned_qac_word_ref values are source observations, not QAC joins. Excluded source entries remain available with their explicit qualification.

word_analysis_qac_alignment.note: Legacy analysis and QAC numbers are separate source namespaces. Use accepted word_morpheme_spans for actual many-to-many joins. The legacy numbering observation is preserved, not used for alignment.

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.

root_lexicon.note: Turkish is the only language with dictionary entries/glosses currently sourced.
